# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming release improves rendering reliability and modernizes Apple, Windows, Uno, and WebAssembly integration. Changes include display-paced Android rendering, Windows custom-font lifetime fixes, Linux HarfBuzz coexistence fixes, and further Skia m156 corrections. Review the Apple deployment minimums and Uno 7 migration requirements before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, retaining any higher framework requirement. These floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 baselines collected in this release line. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno applications to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno views now require Uno 7 and .NET 10; old platform/runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration are retired. Use Uno.Sdk's native assets and .NET SDK WebAssembly pipeline. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses CPU rendering, reports a null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering on Uno; the Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use portable Windows runtime identifiers** — Source-built AnyCPU native-asset imports for SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, and WinUI now recognize win-x86, win-x64, and win-arm64 instead of legacy win10-* identifiers. Update projects using the old identifiers to the matching portable RID. Explicit-platform and empty-RID selection paths are unchanged. ([#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Use matching rebuilt WebAssembly native archives** — WebGPU consumers newer than .NET 8 require rebuilt libSkiaSharp.a archives containing emdawnwebgpu C++ support. Upgrade native assets alongside the managed package and include this support in custom Graphite builds; pre-change and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy the link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Move away from the fork-specific WinRT target** — The fork-specific native WinRT target is retired. Use the supported desktop Windows or WinUI/Windows App SDK integration instead; desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK, and NanoServer remain supported. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Supply valid encoded text buffers** — Font text operations now reject negative byte lengths with ArgumentOutOfRangeException and odd GlyphID byte counts with ArgumentException before native calls. Validate pointer lengths and supply complete 16-bit glyph IDs. Empty and well-formed inputs keep their existing behavior; encoded BreakText overloads return byte counts, while string and char-span overloads return UTF-16 code-unit counts. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Match character-code input to its encoding** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now requires exactly one encoded code unit: use UTF-8 for ASCII, UTF-16 for BMP characters, and UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Previously accepted multi-character UTF-32 input is rejected rather than silently returning its first character. GetString now throws ArgumentNullException, not NullReferenceException, for a null byte array. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Engine

- **More robust glyph and region processing** — Further Skia m156 updates guard glyph bounds and distance-field allocations, avoid oversized remote-glyph rasterization, and size region storage safely for subdivided conics. Graphite corrections cover stroke bounds, complete paint-key comparisons, and inverse-filled shapes outside the scissor. ([#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))
- **Safer runtime-shader failure handling** — SkSL rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. Failed shader construction no longer leaves executable partial pipelines, including transformed child shaders. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))
- **Correct GLES upload configuration** — Ganesh GL no longer selects the BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration that advertised GL_RGBA but was invalid in GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Bounded Windows custom-font data lifetime** — DWriteCore stream-backed typefaces use isolated factories so cached native references do not indefinitely root application font data and its managed release callback. Data remains available while dependent typeface clones are alive and is released after the last clone is disposed. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577))
- **Release WinUI rendering surfaces on teardown** — EGL teardown unbinds this renderer's current context before destroying its surface, allowing the native window and SKGLView platform panel to be collected without unbinding a different context on the calling thread. ([#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of unrestricted buffer swaps. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests and lifecycle progress remain independent of display pacing. Pause, reattachment, and render-mode transitions preserve redraw scheduling. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Reliable native boolean callbacks** — Skia callbacks use the native one-byte boolean width, addressing Apple ARM64 interpreter return-value issues. HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values and honor false glyph-name results without copying name data. Public managed delegates still use bool. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order isolation** — Bundled HarfBuzz functions bind locally, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from intercepting internal calls and mixing incompatible private objects. This addresses load-order crashes without changing exported entry points or managed signatures. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Native string buffer access corrected** — FromCString fixes a native buffer over-read and writes directly to SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows rendering dependencies** — The WinUI ANGLE dependency advances from chromium/6275 to chromium/8118. Windows library dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003; this does not change the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
- **WebAssembly links no longer compile WebGPU C++ support** — WebGPU C++ support is bundled in libSkiaSharp.a, avoiding C++ flags leaking onto application C sources and the resulting link failure. The required JavaScript glue remains a link input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Fewer temporary allocations** — Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation for valid buffers while preserving invalid-input validation. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Native lifetime and callback corrections** — Native cleanup retains the OpenGL module behind cached WGL pointers and corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership. The release also includes a front-buffered stream retention fix. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
